scene.note: A clear view of a stream channel flowing through a wooded area.

findings.question: channel_form
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center: the channel has rounded earthen sides creating a U-shaped profile.

findings.question: bottom_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: the stream bed is hidden under opaque, reflective water.

findings.question: bank_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left and right banks: banks are made of natural soil, moss, and tree roots.

findings.question: habitats
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: no sand banks, stone deposits, riffles, or aquatic plants are visible.

findings.question: natural_debris
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center of channel: fallen branches and twigs are resting in and above the water.

findings.question: water_flow
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: the still photo cannot distinguish whether the flat water is slowly moving or stagnant.

findings.question: water_aspect
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: the water surface is opaque and greyish, preventing a view into the water.

findings.question: water_withdrawal
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel and banks: no water intake, pump, or diversion channel is visible.

findings.question: barriers
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: no dam, weir, or artificial barrier crosses the stream.

findings.question: draining_pipes
findings.evidence: downstream photo, both banks: no drainage pipes are visible along the banks.

findings.question: sewage_discharge
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: no sewage entry or discharge is visible.

findings.question: construction
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel and banks: no construction works, machinery, or materials are present.

findings.question: impervious_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: the area consists entirely of woodland with no paved surfaces or buildings.

findings.question: impervious_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: the area consists entirely of woodland with no paved surfaces or buildings.

findings.question: vegetation_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: the bank and adjacent ground are covered with dense trees and woodland plants.

findings.question: vegetation_type_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: mature trees dominate the margin area within five meters of the bank.

findings.question: vegetation_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: the bank and adjacent ground are covered with trees and woodland vegetation.

findings.question: vegetation_type_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: trees dominate the margin area within five meters of the bank.

findings.question: vegetation_cut
findings.evidence: downstream photo, both banks: there are no signs of recently cut trees, stumps, or cleared vegetation.
